title: Practice 2.2
role: Colleague giving advice to someone who is afraid of a presentation
can_do: I can give advice and instructions to help someone overcome a fear.
I can calm someone down with firm, kind language and first conditional sentences.

items.prompt: Which sentence is a first conditional?

options.text: If you breathe slowly, you will feel calmer.
If you had breathed slowly, you would have felt calmer.
If you breathed slowly, you would feel calmer.

items.explanation: First conditional: if + present simple, will + verb.

o2.text: This is a third conditional about the past.

o3.text: This is a second conditional about an unreal situation.

items.template: If you feel nervous, {1} one friendly face.

error_tag.text: Advice often uses the base verb: look at.

items.explanation: An instruction uses the base form of the verb.

items.template: If you rehearse, you {1} feel more confident.

error_tag.text: The result clause of a first conditional uses will.

items.explanation: A direct instruction starts with the verb: Take a deep breath.

error_tag.text: Instructions start with the base verb.

items.prompt: Match the phrase with its purpose.
items.explanation: Each phrase has a different calming function.

items.prompt: Give advice to someone who is nervous. Use If you feel nervous.
accepted: If you feel nervous take a deep breath
If you feel nervous breathe slowly
If you feel nervous focus on one face
If you feel nervous pause and breathe
items.explanation: If you feel nervous + an instruction.
